values.note: 8 sites: 5 drive-in (1, 3-6) and 3 walk-in tent sites (7-9); site 2 is the host. Each has a tent pad, fire grate, bear locker and picnic table. The FS page gives parking spurs of 35-45 ft; the forest's status table says 6 sites with a 20-ft max spur (see flags). RVs and trailers must fit on the spur.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/big-bend-campground ('There are eight sites available, including three walk-in tent sites. Each site contains a tent pad, fire grate, bear locker and picnic table.'; 'RVs, trailers or other vehicles must fit on the parking spur because driving or parking off road is not permitted. The parking length ranges from 35 to 45 feet.') + campground map PDF (drive-in sites 1-6 with 2 marked Host Site, walk-in sites 7-9) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Big Bend | 6 | Max Spur 20'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Bear lockers at every site. Bighorn sheep viewing station on the entrance road.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/big-bend-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'; 'There is a bighorn sheep viewing station along the entrance road to the campground.') + campground map PDF (drinking water and toilet symbols), read 2026-10-28

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Canyon Lakes Ranger District Campground Status: Big Bend, Operating Season 'May 22 - Sept 20'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: First-come, first-served only. Up to eight people per site.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/big-bend-campground ('Reservations: First come, first served campground'; 'A single site may hold up to eight people.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions ('First-come, first-served'), read 2026-10-28

note: USFS (Arapaho-Roosevelt NF, Canyon Lakes RD), run by a concessionaire; ~7,700 ft on a sagebrush and open-conifer flat beside the Cache la Poudre, off CO-14 about 39 mi up the canyon from US-287. Excellent fishing. --Claude
summary: FS page + map + ARP status table: confirmed 8 sites (5 drive-in, 3 walk-in tent), vault toilets, FCFS only, $23. Added potable water (the page says it is available), max 45 ft from the page's 35-45 ft spurs (the status table says 20 ft - flagged), season 05-22..09-20, booking note. Note trimmed of field restatements.
flags: Max length conflict (criteria check): the FS campground page says 'The parking length ranges from 35 to 45 feet', but the forest's Campground Status table lists Big Bend with 6 sites and Max Spur 20' - under 23 ft. Recorded 45 from the campground page. Imagery supports the page: the river-side drive-in spurs measure roughly 20 m (~65 ft) long from the loop road. A human should confirm before relying on either.
Website is only the ARP recreation index; replace it with the campground's page, https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/big-bend-campground.
Missing phone: Canyon Lakes Ranger District 970-295-6600 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/offices).
Operator: the campground map says 'Big Bend Campground is managed by a concessionaire under a special use permit from the U.S. Forest Service' (not named). Ownership federal stands.

Riverfront (stored) is borderline - re-audit lead, waterfront not changed. On imagery the river-side spurs end ~20-30 m from the Poudre's water through a band of conifers and willows on the bank; no clearly open apron to the water is visible, though there are gaps.
Pin 40.7077,-105.726 sits inside the camping loop (good). The FS page's lat/lng 40.710414,-105.726567 is the entrance on CO-14, ~300 m N. Not on recreation.gov, so no per-site points.
Status: 'Site Closed' badge on the FS page today, consistent with the May 22 - Sept 20 season; no closure order or alert for CO-14 or the campground.
